FXFV2-A4-P1.mechanism_read: Tokyo-session range (9 bars, 09:00-18:00 JST) with compression state 1{range < 0.75 x trailing-20-valid-session median}; first London-morning [08:00,12:00) Europe/London H1 bar whose high/low breaches the Tokyo extreme triggers entry at the next H1 open in the breach direction; invalidation = completed close back inside the range; forced flat 16:00 America/New_York bar open.
FXFV2-A4-P1.vs_family1: NOT a variant. The signal object changed (prior-session extreme level breach vs open-relative 3-bar momentum), the cadence changed (conditional ~25-35% of days vs unconditional daily), and an invalidation exit exists. However the anchor remains a London-morning continuation trade: same session window as family1 and, on compression days, the breach side will frequently equal the open-momentum sign. This is the neighborhood, not the mechanism.
FXFV2-A4-P1.vs_family2: No fade anywhere; different session pair (Tokyo->London); no standardized-extension observable. Clean.
FXFV2-A4-P1.vs_near_duplicate: No session-to-session momentum carry; entries at/before the duplicate's 12:00-London fill on a ~30% subset of days with a different direction source. Not the duplicate.
FXFV2-A4-P1.lineage_disclosure: MEDIUM - FXFV2-A4-P1 is a materially re-specified descendant of V1's UNSELECTED, NEVER-SCORED FXFV1-A4-P1 ('Tokyo-morning range contraction -> London-morning expansion breakout': 6-bar Tokyo range, first completed-bar CLOSE beyond the range in [08:00,12:00) London, opposite-extreme stop, 15:00 NY flatten). V2 changes: quantified compression gate (0.75 x trailing-20 median) that V1 lacked as a trigger condition, intrabar-extreme touch trigger vs close-beyond, 9-bar vs 6-bar Tokyo window, invalidation exit, 16:00 vs 15:00 NY flat, midpoint placebo control. Eligible: V1 A4-P1 has no observed outcome, so 'result-aware reuse' cannot apply, and this audit is the independent novelty decision over a fresh blind packet. Not a fault of A4 (firewall forbade reading V1 proposals), but the lineage must travel with the proposal into selection.
FXFV2-A4-P1.control_adequacy: ADEQUATE. The midpoint placebo holds compression, windows, exits and clock fixed and removes exactly the claimed ingredient (level placement at the extremes). If the real edge were generic compression-conditional London-morning momentum (the family1-like alternative), the midpoint control would cross in the move direction on nearly every valid state day and would reproduce the anchor - and the frozen failure_interpretation then self-rejects. The control cannot rescue the anchor and can only kill it: correct direction of inference. LOW caveat (disclosed in the proposal): the control fires more often, so the weekly governor cap truncates its schedule and changes day composition relative to the anchor.
FXFV2-A4-P1.usd_explainability: GAP - MEDIUM. No USD neutrality is claimed (permitted; PLAN section 12 gates neutrality only 'where the proposal claims neutrality'), but the only scheduled USD diagnostic is explicitly non-gated and descriptive. A coherent broad-USD-drift explanation of the anchor (breakout days clustering in the USD direction across all 7 pairs) would be caught by NO frozen gate: the direction_check counts quoted-pair long/short, not USD-leg sign. A6-P1/P2 freeze D1-D3 diagnostics for exactly this exposure; A4-P1/A4-P2 freeze none. Recommendation to the scorer (audit recommendation, not a repair): apply A6-style D1-D3 USD-leg diagnostics to both A4 anchors at Stage-A before any survivor is locked.

FXFV2-A4-P2.mechanism_read: London-AM range (4 bars, 08:00-12:00 Europe/London); first completed bar in [12:00,17:00) breaching the range extreme; entry at next H1 open in the break direction ONLY after a retest-hold bar (touch of the broken level + close beyond it) within [12:00,19:00); invalidation = close back inside the pre-break range; forced flat 16:00 America/New_York bar open; no volatility filter.
FXFV2-A4-P2.vs_family1: NOT a variant. Different session phase (London afternoon resolution of a morning range vs London-open momentum), conditional (~35-45% of days), trigger = level break + reaction state, invalidation exit. Still a London-direction continuation trade: on trend days it holds the same direction family1 would have held, hours later and only on retest-hold days.
FXFV2-A4-P2.vs_family2: No fade; no standardized extension; different clock. Clean.
FXFV2-A4-P2.vs_near_duplicate: NOT the V1 near-duplicate (V1 A4-P2: unconditional sign of the 3-4-bar London-morning move, fixed 12:00-London fill, no retest state). V2 A4-P2 requires a break of the London-AM range plus a retest-hold reaction bar, entering later (13:00-19:00 London) on a subset of days. Different schedule in trigger, timing and conditioning.
FXFV2-A4-P2.lineage_disclosure: No V1 ancestor found. The retest-hold confirmation filter and the complement-state control are new relative to all six V1 proposals read by A7-N.
FXFV2-A4-P2.control_adequacy: ADEQUATE. The control is the complement state (trade the void/failed-retest bar in the original break direction) - it holds break detection, session, clock, cost and caps identical and removes exactly the proposed ingredient (the retest-hold state). It would reproduce the anchor only if continuation were state-independent (unconditional breakout), in which case the frozen failure_interpretation self-rejects. The proposal also documents rejecting an unconditional-break-at-first-touch control because it would have embedded a rival mechanism - correct reasoning. LOW caveat: the control's invalidation law (close beyond the OPPOSITE extreme) differs from the anchor's (close back inside the range); this is a defensible fairness choice (anchor-law invalidation would near-instantly stop void-day entries) but makes the anchor/control exit laws asymmetric.

FXFV2-A5-P1.mechanism_read: Cross-sectional, USD-factor-neutral extreme-vs-extreme RV: at the 12:00Z bar completion, day-to-date USD-view log increments are demeaned by the equal-weighted 7-pair index and z-standardized by trailing 20-day residual sigma; if the z-range >= 3.0, long argmin / short argmax, equal notional; half-reversion exit (0.5 x entry spread) or forced flat 16:00 NY bar open; 6 bps RT base cost.
FXFV2-A5-P1.vs_family1: No session-open clock, no open-relative direction, no single-pair directional bet. Clean.
FXFV2-A5-P1.vs_family2: No fade of a standardized extension; the z-standardization is used for cross-sectional RANKING (pair selection), not as a single-pair extension gate, and the direction is relative (spread), not a pair-direction fade. Clean.
FXFV2-A5-P1.lineage_disclosure: No V1 ancestor: none of the six V1 proposals is a same-day demeaned cross-sectional dislocation trade (V1 A5-P1 was a EUR/USD-anchored lead-lag; V1 A5-P2 was NY-morning intraday momentum).
FXFV2-A5-P1.control_adequacy: ADEQUATE. The placebo de-links ranking via a SHA-256 date-seeded hash pair choice while keeping gate evaluation, schedule, cost and forced flat identical; any expectancy surviving the placebo is declared a schedule/selection artifact and voids the claim. A hash placebo cannot reproduce a convergence mechanism except by luck, and if it does the proposal self-voids: correct inference direction. The trailing-4h neighbour tests the measurement-window presumption and is preregistered to move together.
FXFV2-A5-P1.usd_explainability: ADEQUATE - algebra checked by A7-N. u_p = s_p x log-increment; portfolio return = u_L - u_S = (e_L + m) - (e_S + m) = e_L - e_S: the equal-weighted USD index m cancels EXACTLY to first order for equal +1/-1 units, independent of the selected pairs; the honesty_note correctly limits the claim (second-order convexity and unequal per-pair vols not neutralized; proxy is the 7-pair index, not DXY).
FXFV2-A5-P1.source_integrity: VERIFIED. Lustig, Roussanov & Verdelhan (2011, Journal of Finance 66(4), 'Common Risk Factors in Currency Markets') is real and the dollar-factor/demeaning characterization is accurate. Osler 2003 verified (above).

FXFV2-A5-P2.mechanism_read: Cross-sectional USD-neutral outlier-basket reversal: prior NY-rollover trading session demeaned z-standardized returns; if z-range >= 2.0, long bottom-2 vs short top-2 baskets (4 legs, 12 bps RT base) at the 08:00Z bar open; hold-to-flat at 16:00 NY bar open.
FXFV2-A5-P2.vs_family1: No session clock in the signal; symmetric cross-sectional construction. Clean.
FXFV2-A5-P2.vs_family2: Reversal direction is cross-sectional (sell yesterday's cross-sectional winners / buy losers after demeaning), not a single-pair fade of a vol-standardized same-session extension; different clock (T-1 session -> 08:00Z today vs NY 4-bar window); different object. Clean.
FXFV2-A5-P2.lineage_disclosure: No V1 ancestor among the six V1 proposals.
FXFV2-A5-P2.control_adequacy: ADEQUATE WITH A GRADED-DELINK CAVEAT - MEDIUM. The stale-ranking control (T-2 instead of T-1) removes the specific 'today's flow unwinds YESTERDAY'S outliers' link, but cross-sectional ranks of demeaned returns are positively autocorrelated day-over-day, so T-2 is correlated with T-1: the de-link is graded, not clean. If the true reversal horizon were ~2 days, the control would partially reproduce the anchor; the frozen rule (positive stale-ranking expectancy voids the mechanism claim) handles that conservatively (it may reject a real-but-different slower mechanism, which is safe), but PARTIAL reproduction has no frozen interpretation. Unlike A5-P1 there is no hash placebo to triangulate. Acceptable as frozen; noted for the scorer's interpretation.
FXFV2-A5-P2.usd_explainability: ADEQUATE - algebra checked: 2v2 equal units give sum(x)=0 so m cancels exactly to first order; a preregistered usd_drift_explanation failure mode exists in failure_interpretation.
FXFV2-A5-P2.source_integrity: VERIFIED. Nagel (2012, RFS 25(7), 'Evaporating Liquidity') is real; the liquidity-provision rationale is the paper's thesis.

FXFV2-A6-P1.mechanism_read: Compression->expansion state transition with NO session clock: state = 24-bar true-range sum below the median of 10 prior non-overlapping 24-bar blocks; trigger = first-of-day H1 CLOSE beyond the prior-48-bar high/low channel (decision bar excluded); direction = breach side; entry next H1 open; single exit 16:00 NY bar open.
FXFV2-A6-P1.vs_family1: NOT a variant. No session-open term, no open-relative momentum, no session label anywhere in state/trigger/direction (verified in spec); the trigger is evaluable any hour and the conditioning is a realized-vol state. The unconditional 48-bar channel breach is generic Donchian-style breakout, which is NOT itself a forbidden family - and the control arm is exactly that unconditional breakout, with a frozen self-reject rule (control expectancy >= 0.5x anchor or control PF >= 1.10 with positive sign).
FXFV2-A6-P1.vs_family2: Never fades; no standardized extension; no NY clock. Clean.
FXFV2-A6-P1.lineage_disclosure: No V1 ancestor: the closest V1 proposals (A4-P1 compression breakout) key on a session clock and session range; A6-P1's clock-free state design is genuinely different in trigger, dedup and any-hour coverage.
FXFV2-A6-P1.control_adequacy: ADEQUATE. Deleting the compression gate removes exactly the proposed ingredient (the state transition) while keeping the breakout machinery; any generic-breakout edge lands in the control and the frozen numeric self-reject rule converts a reproduced control into rejection. The cap-truncation composition caveat (control fires more often, caps bind more) is disclosed (frequency_note). LOW: the 0.5x/PF-1.10 thresholds are the auditor-checked frozen quantification of 'control reproduces' - reasonable and preregistered.
FXFV2-A6-P1.usd_explainability: ADEQUATE. Null construction with FROZEN falsification diagnostics D1 (USD-leg imbalance |share-0.5|>0.15 per fold), D2 (cross-sectional USD-leg coherence |mean|>0.25), D3 (conditional expectancy split by USD leg with fold stability) - meaningful and preregistered; concentration gate also reports USD-leg share.
FXFV2-A6-P1.source_integrity: VERIFIED with one LOW typo. Osler 2003 real (pages misprinted as '1791-1916'; correct 1791-1819). Engle 1982 (Econometrica 50(4), 987-1007, ARCH) real; the volatility-clustering/predictability claim is exactly the paper's contribution.

FXFV2-A6-P2.mechanism_read: Session-liquidity state transition: thin-Asian state (UTC 00:00-06:00 high-low range below trailing 15-day median, >=10 baseline days) AND first turnover burst (TR > 1.5 x same-day Asian median TR, UTC hours 06-09); direction OPPOSITE the Asian drift (close(05:00Z) - open(00:00Z) sign); entry next H1 open; single exit 16:00 NY bar open.
FXFV2-A6-P2.vs_family1: NOT a variant. Direction is AGAINST the measured Asian drift, not with any session-open move; trigger is a data-detected range burst, not a clock; the proposal fully discloses that the burst window brackets the London handoff. Verified: no session-open direction term exists.
FXFV2-A6-P2.vs_family2: NOT a nearby-clock/threshold/horizon variant of the late-NY standardized-extension fade: clock is 06-10 UTC (vs late-NY 17-21 UTC); the measured quantity is the raw 6-hour Asian drift (vs a z-standardized 4-bar NY extension); and the conditioning state (thin-Asian range) is absent from family2. MEDIUM adjacency finding recorded, however: rejected family2's Tokyo-open neighbour arm (scored and rejected in V1: expectancy -2.7196, PF 0.8874, 142 trades) was also a fade of an Asian-session displacement toward the same 16:00 NY flat. A6-P2 shares that fade-the-Asian-move genus. The operative safeguard is structural and frozen: the control arm deletes the thin-state gate, so the family2-neighbour-like UNCONDITIONAL Asian-drift fade IS the control; if the control reproduces the anchor (>=0.5x or PF>=1.10), the proposal self-rejects. The novelty claim therefore stands or falls exactly on the state-conditioning, which is the claimed mechanism.
FXFV2-A6-P2.lineage_disclosure: No V1 proposal fades the Asian drift under a thin-state gate with a burst trigger. The A6 search_log documents candidates rejected for forbidden-family proximity (including all clock-keyed continuation and late-session fade variants).
FXFV2-A6-P2.control_adequacy: ADEQUATE. Same structure as A6-P1: delete exactly the thin-state gate, keep the burst detector, reversion direction, caps, clocks; frozen numeric self-reject rule. The control is precisely the unconditional Asian-drift fade (the family2-adjacent rival), so a reproduced control kills the proposal. LOW: cap-truncation composition caveat disclosed.
FXFV2-A6-P2.usd_explainability: ADEQUATE. Null construction with frozen D1-D3 diagnostics identical in form to A6-P1; Asian windows are DST-invariant UTC, so no hidden session-clock drift channel.
